notes: Fresh Sep 17 Toronto-morning B_V1 review of all 163 judge candidates. Entity-accuracy hard rejects were applied aggressively to common-word/ticker collisions and unrelated mappings; evergreen commentary, generic predictions and weak/noisy evidence were rejected. Duplicate Fed, Amazon/Generac, Bitcoin/CLARITY, BOE and other repeated angles were collapsed to one underlying event. Twelve strongest distinct events were retained rather than padding. Evidence arrays preserve the supplied judge-review evidence used for semantic judging, while upstream evidence counts remain intact.
